array_semantics: objects/profile_refs and reference lists are sets; expression operand arrays remain ordered syntax
compilation_rules: Closed exact shapes, no type coercion; all references exist with permitted kinds.
Normalize all declared set arrays; no implicit Unicode/string normalization.
Pin exact installed profile contract and exact compiler realization, never a profile supplied by input.
Unconditional dependencies order steps using a lexicographic ready queue; cycles refuse.
Targets shared by transitions require an explicit transitive order; same-target concurrent transitions refuse.
Initial states are required for touched targets and follow the ordered declared chain; compatibility here is literal state equality only.
Each source obligation, effect requirement and applicable policy generates a source-linked guard.
Every step has runtime evidence and scoped authorization guards; every effect adds adapter-binding and precondition guards.
Retire steps add seven unresolved retirement guards; source-supplied true observations cannot discharge them.
Constant-fold only literal conditions; eq observations are always symbolic even with supplied values.
Emit IR, deterministic diagnostics and compilation receipt; no live fact read, clock, signing, API calls or action.
Recompilation must byte-match the complete candidate; hash consistency alone does not verify semantic lowering.
states: ASCII tokens, no inherent security meaning
